subject: local owner and execution authority
decision: Implement one reserved owner with UV-required resident passkeys, absolute sessions and local filesystem-authorized recovery. Keep provider execution unavailable by default; expose typed owner contracts without browser worker authority.
context: Implementation choice within user-authorized local E01/E02 scope, 2026-11-11; docs/adr/ADR-004-owner-authority-and-foundations.md. Server access and full V1 qualification remain deferred.
